credits.name: nostr-tools
credits.author: fiatjaf and contributors (nbd-wtf)
credits.used_for: Connecting to Nostr relays, reading notes, reposts, reactions and zaps, decoding npub and NIP-05 addresses. Shipped as its own browser bundle (version 2.25.2).

credits.name: nostr-login
credits.author: Nostr.Band
credits.used_for: The optional "Sign in with Nostr Login" button (extension, Nostr Connect or read-only). It loads only when you press that button. Version 1.7.12, unchanged.

credits.name: soundcn
credits.author: kapishdima (sounds by Kenney)
credits.used_for: The earcons: nine sounds from its Kenney Interface Sounds and Digital Audio packs, converted from Ogg to MP3. Its World of Warcraft collection is not used.
credits.notice: Sounds are CC0 by Kenney (kenney.nl); the pack license is in sounds/Kenney-License.txt. soundcn's MIT text is in licenses/soundcn.txt.

credits.name: speakable
credits.author: tollwerk GmbH
credits.used_for: js/speech.js is adapted from it: voice lookup by language, local voices first, the iOS Safari voice-list workaround, and sentence-sized utterances.
credits.files: js/speech.js (changed: works on strings, adds speed, voice choice, a watchdog and cancel)
credits.notice: Copyright (c) 2020 tollwerk GmbH, MIT text kept.

credits.name: moodist
credits.author: MAZE (remvze)
credits.used_for: js/ambient.js adapts its WAV encoder and its trick of looping generated audio in a plain audio element. No moodist sound files are used, because its repo mixes CC0 and Pixabay-licensed clips without saying which file is which. The rain, brown noise and hum beds are generated in your browser instead.
credits.files: js/ambient.js (changed: mono, volume baked in, procedural beds)

credits.name: web-haptics
credits.author: lochie
credits.used_for: The buzz for zaps and mentions. Version 0.0.6, its two dist files joined into one module, code unchanged.

credits.name: a11y-dialog
credits.author: Kitty Giraudel
credits.notice: Copyright Kitty Giraudel, MIT text kept.

starred_not_used.name: bitcoin-connect
starred_not_used.why: Starred and allowed, but connecting a wallet adds a lot of weight for one key. Z opens the note in a Nostr app (via njump.me) where you can zap with your own wallet.
